paper.title: Blast Radius
paper.abstract: Agentic coding faces growing problems of affordability and wasted tokens. We introduce Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach through coupled context and code channels. NECROPHORESIS enables reversible eviction by archiving dead context verbatim, while Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries repeatedly occurring transcripts. We formulate reversible context eviction over a Polish context space, providing a measurable foundation for r

summary.core_problem: Agentic coding 中 token 浪费和上下文溢出问题，需要可预测的上下文内存管理层。
summary.importance: 系统/方法贡献：提出 Blast Radius 预测性内存管理层，通过可逆上下文驱逐降低 token 消耗。
summary.technical_approach: NECROPHORESIS 逐字归档死亡上下文实现可逆驱逐；Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) 识别并埋葬重复出现的 transcript；在 Polish context space 上形式化可逆驱逐。
summary.experiments: 在 7 个 OpenAI 模型上 token 消耗降低 17-26%，溢出率最低，且字节级可逆。450 个被埋葬上下文中 378 个为 RDM，0 个被召回。

summary_en.core_problem: Token waste and context overflow in agentic coding, requiring a predictive context memory management layer.
summary_en.importance: System/method contribution: Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that reduces token consumption via reversible context eviction.
summary_en.technical_approach: NECROPHORESIS archives dead context verbatim for reversible eviction; Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries recurring transcripts; formalizes reversible eviction over a Polish context space.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 OpenAI models, token consumption reduced by 17-26%, lowest overflow rate, byte-exact reversible. Of 450 buried contexts, 378 were RDM and zero were recalled.

recommendation.zh: 工程向的 coding agent 上下文管理，17-26% token 节省有实际意义，但方法偏启发式，对 pretrain 研究员仅作系统设计参考。
recommendation.en: Engineering-focused context management for coding agents; the 17-26% token saving is practically meaningful but the method is heuristic—only useful as system design reference for pretrain researchers.

paper.title: Every Time I Hire a Linguist, Inference Costs Go Down: On Linguistic Rules as Effective Prompt Compressors
paper.abstract: Prompt compression shortens LLM input to reduce inference cost, yet existing methods score token importance through LM forward passes. It remains questionable whether such nuanced, costly token selection is necessary. Compression requires identifying informative content, a problem that linguistic research has long addressed through cues that can be operationalized as deterministic rules. We therefore ask: can \textbf{linguistic rules alone} serve as effective prompt compressors, without LM-based

summary.core_problem: 现有 prompt compression 多依赖 LM 前向打分来选 token，压缩时计算开销高；问题是是否必须用这种昂贵的“细粒度重要性”估计。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧效率方法：证明（或至少实证）一类无需模型打分、纯规则的压缩器也能在若干任务上接近/达到可用效果，适合成本敏感部署与边缘侧预处理。
summary.technical_approach: 提出用语言学规则做确定性压缩：从词汇/句法/语义/篇章等规则种子出发，离线用 evolutionary search 搜索规则组合；部署时仅 CPU 规则处理，不做任何 LM forward pass。并用 dual-path protocol 同时评估压缩后任务表现与重建保真度。
summary.experiments: 覆盖短文本、multi-document reasoning、对话记忆 QA 等数据集（摘要截断，未给出压缩率、具体对比方法、提升幅度与统计显著性）。

summary_en.core_problem: Most prompt compression methods require LM forward passes to score token importance, making compression-time compute expensive; the question is whether such costly scoring is necessary.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution: it argues that deterministic, linguistics-rule-based compressors can be competitive without any model scoring at deployment, which matters for cost-sensitive or edge preprocessing.
summary_en.technical_approach: They build a rule-based compressor from lexical/syntactic/semantic/discourse cues, and use offline evolutionary search to find strong rule combinations. At inference, compression runs on CPU with zero LM forward passes. A dual-path protocol evaluates both downstream performance and reconstruction fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on short passages, multi-document reasoning, and dialogue-memory QA datasets (abstract is truncated; compression ratios, baselines, and margins are not specified).

recommendation.zh: 当作“无模型打分的压缩基线”备查即可；想省钱就看它的 dual-path 指标与规则搜索空间，别指望改变预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a handy baseline for zero-forward-pass prompt compression; skim the dual-path metrics and the rule search space—unlikely to shift any pretraining priors.

paper.title: How enabling two settings tripled our scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
paper.abstract: How two API settings improved GPT-5.6 performance on ARC-AGI-3, boosting scores and efficiency by retaining reasoning and enabling compaction.

summary.core_problem: 如何通过调整API设置（保留推理过程和启用压缩）来大幅提升模型在复杂推理基准（ARC-AGI-3）上的表现？
summary.importance: OpenAI官方技术博客，揭示了推理时计算（test-time compute）和上下文管理对提升模型（GPT-5.6）在极难推理任务上性能的关键作用，直接关系到当前最前沿的推理扩展（inference scaling）范式。
summary.technical_approach: 通过开启两个特定的API设置：1) 保留推理过程（retaining reasoning），允许模型在多步交互中累积和利用之前的思考过程；2) 启用压缩（enabling compaction），优化长上下文的处理效率。这两种机制结合，使得模型能够处理更长、更复杂的推理链。
summary.experiments: 在ARC-AGI-3基准测试上，GPT-5.6的得分提升了三倍，同时提高了效率。
summary.authors_note: OpenAI Research 官方发布，代表了顶级机构在提升模型推理能力方面的最新工程实践和洞察。

summary_en.core_problem: How to significantly improve model performance on complex reasoning benchmarks (ARC-AGI-3) by adjusting API settings (retaining reasoning and enabling compaction)?
summary_en.importance: Official OpenAI technical blog revealing the critical role of test-time compute and context management in boosting model (GPT-5.6) performance on extremely difficult reasoning tasks, directly related to the frontier paradigm of inference scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: By enabling two specific API settings: 1) retaining reasoning, allowing the model to accumulate and utilize previous thought processes across multi-step interactions; 2) enabling compaction, optimizing the efficiency of long context processing. The combination of these mechanisms enables the model to handle longer and more complex reasoning chains.
summary_en.experiments: Tripled the score of GPT-5.6 on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark while improving efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: Official release by OpenAI Research, representing the latest engineering practices and insights from a top institution in enhancing model reasoning capabilities.

recommendation.zh: OpenAI官方揭秘GPT-5.6在ARC上提分的关键trick，证明了长上下文下的推理状态保留（test-time compute的延续）对复杂推理至关重要，必读。
recommendation.en: OpenAI officially reveals the key tricks for GPT-5.6's score boost on ARC, proving that reasoning state retention (continuation of test-time compute) under long context is crucial for complex reasoning, a must-read.

paper.title: CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents
paper.abstract: LLM coding agents operate by constructing trajectories that accumulate reasoning, tool calls, and results to enable multi-step decision-making. However, the conventional append-only trajectory architecture found in practice tightly couples file-read actions with their observations, capturing snapshots that become permanently fixed in the chronological history. As files change through agent edits or concurrent human modifications, these snapshots become stale, causing reasoning errors and causing

summary.core_problem: 解决代码 Agent 轨迹中“文件读取结果被永久写入历史”导致的上下文膨胀与代码状态过期问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Coding Agent 的上下文架构改进。它不直接改进基座预训练，但指出了长期工具轨迹里状态同步和 token 预算之间的结构性矛盾，对仓库级 Agent 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CORVUS，将 file-read action 与 observation 解耦。系统维护一个与代码库当前状态同步的文件注册表，在每轮推理时只注入相关文件的最新内容，而不是把每次读取快照追加进历史轨迹。核心变化是把“时间序列日志”改成“可同步状态视图”。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明该方法产生更轻量的轨迹，并通过构造保证与真实代码库状态同步；未给出具体模型规模、任务集、baseline、token 节省比例或成功率提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context bloat and stale file snapshots in coding agents caused by append-only trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent context architecture contribution rather than a pretraining result. Its useful signal is the separation between chronological tool logs and synchronized workspace state, which matters for repository-level agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: CORVUS decouples file-read actions from their observations. It maintains a synchronized registry of relevant files and injects only current file contents at each reasoning cycle, replacing repeated historical snapshots with a live state view.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims lighter trajectories and synchronization by construction, but does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, token reductions, or task success gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计图就够了；对预训练无直接动作，但“状态视图替代日志堆叠”是代码 Agent 的干净抽象。
recommendation.en: Skim the system design only; it does not inform pretraining directly, but the live-state-view abstraction is clean for coding agents.

paper.title: ACM: Agentic Context Management for Long Horizon Tasks
paper.abstract: Agentic tasks are inherently long-horizon and multi-turn, constantly accumulating context through interactions with the environment. Existing context compression methods inevitably incur information loss and are triggered by rigid heuristic rules, leaving them misaligned with the agent's evolving reasoning focus. We propose Agentic Context Management (ACM), a framework that equips agents with purpose-built context editing tools for lossless context management. Inspired by the interaction between

summary.core_problem: 长时序多轮agent的上下文持续累积，现有压缩方法存在信息损失且依赖僵化启发式规则，无法匹配动态推理焦点。
summary.importance: 提出自主式上下文管理框架，实现无损的动态上下文维护，配套后训练pipeline提升agent任务性能。
summary.technical_approach: 模拟人类长短记忆交互机制，为agent提供上下文编辑工具，由agent自主决策压缩时机，将丢弃内容卸载到外部记忆系统按需查询；构造高质量上下文管理演示数据做后训练。
summary.experiments: 在智能体搜索和代码任务上取得性能提升，分析显示该框架可有效降低上下文峰值token压力。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multi-turn agents accumulate context continuously, while existing compression methods cause information loss and rely on rigid heuristic rules, misaligned with dynamic reasoning focus.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an agentic context management framework for lossless dynamic context maintenance, with a supporting post-training pipeline to improve agent task performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by human short-term/long-term memory interaction, equips agents with context editing tools, lets agents autonomously decide when to compress, offloads discarded content to external memory for on-demand retrieval; constructs high-quality context management demonstrations for post-training.
summary_en.experiments: Achieves performance gains on agentic search and coding tasks, analysis shows the framework effectively reduces peak token pressure in context.

recommendation.zh: agent长上下文无损管理框架，自主决策加外部记忆卸载的思路对长序列建模有弱启发，只看框架设计部分即可
recommendation.en: Lossless long-context agent management framework, the autonomous decision + external memory offloading idea is weakly inspiring for long-sequence modeling, only read the framework design section

paper.title: ArbiGraph: Arbitrarily Scalable Verifiable Task Graphs for Evaluating Context Management
paper.abstract: We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and valu

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测难以精确控制任务复杂度与依赖结构，无法系统评估LLM在长推理工作流中的上下文管理能力。
summary.importance: 提出首个可任意扩展、可自动验证的任务图benchmark生成器，可系统评测上下文管理的不同维度，属于评测方法与工具创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将每个任务表示为带可执行Python求解器的自然语言问题，通过类型化中间状态（标量、列表）组合成任务图，可灵活调整任务长度、依赖结构、干扰项数量、值类型，通过执行求解器实现精确自动验证。
summary.experiments: 用数学、GSM应用题、Python追踪三类任务实例化，在四种拓扑结构上评测Qwen3.5-27B工具辅助Agent，发现分支依赖的数学任务上准确率最多下降33.3%，单任务评测无法暴露这类缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Gennady Pekhimenko（多伦多大学，ML系统与高效计算方向）、Mark C. Jeffrey（多伦多大学，计算机系统方向）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks cannot precisely control task complexity and dependency structure, making it hard to systematically evaluate LLMs' context management abilities in extended reasoning workflows.
summary_en.importance: First arbitrarily scalable, automatically verifiable task graph benchmark generator for systematic evaluation of context management dimensions; represents evaluation methodology and tool innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task is a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver; tasks are composed via typed intermediate states (scalars, lists) into task graphs with adjustable length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type, enabling exact automatic verification via solver execution.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated with math, GSM-style word problems, and Python tracing tasks; evaluates Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies, finding up to 33.3% accuracy drop on branching dependent math tasks — failures not exposed by single-task benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Gennady Pekhimenko (University of Toronto, ML systems and efficient computing) and Mark C. Jeffrey (University of Toronto, computer systems).

recommendation.zh: 可控任务图评测上下文管理能力，设计干净，预训练研究员可参考其评测范式验证模型长上下文依赖能力，重点看§3任务构造。
recommendation.en: Cleanly designed controllable task graph benchmark for context management; pretraining researchers can reference its paradigm to test long-context dependency abilities, focus on §3 task construction.

paper.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
paper.abstract: Production AI agents' failures are less often due to an inability to reason well and more often because they cannot manage what is in their reasoning context: conversation histories, large prompts, large tool definitions, and ballooning tool outputs. Agents drown in their own accumulating history while paying a token cost that grows every turn, producing missing recalls within and across conversations. The incumbent response treats this as a storage-and-retrieval problem. We argue that framing i

summary.core_problem: 生产环境 Agent 失败常源于上下文管理（历史累积、工具输出膨胀、token 成本随轮次线性增长），而非推理能力本身。
summary.importance: 提出将 Agent 记忆/上下文视为生命周期与架构问题而非单纯存储检索问题的视角，给出工程化分层框架。
summary.technical_approach: 把上下文管理拆成 decide what to remember / extract & structure / per-type store / consolidate & forget / relevance selection / anticipation / compaction 等阶段，并引入组织级 scope 层级。
summary.experiments: 论文为立场/框架性文章，未给出定量实验与模型对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Production agent failures often stem from context management (accumulating history, bloated tool outputs, per-turn token cost growth) rather than weak reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Reframes agent memory as a lifecycle-and-architecture problem rather than storage-and-retrieval, proposing a layered engineering framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes context management into stages: what to remember, extraction/structuring, typed stores, consolidation/forgetting with provenance, relevance selection, next-need anticipation, and budgeted compaction, plus organizational scope hierarchy.
summary_en.experiments: Position/architecture paper; no quantitative experiments or model comparisons reported.

recommendation.zh: 工程视角的清单式文章，没有实验；做长上下文/Agent serving 的人扫一眼框架即可，预训练侧基本无新信息。
recommendation.en: A checklist-style engineering position piece with no experiments; skim the framework if you build long-context agent serving, otherwise skip for pretrain.

paper.title: PRO-LONG: Programmatic Memory Enables Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon tasks require sustained perception, reasoning, and exploration, and are a persistent challenge for large language model (LLM) agents. This gap is reflected in their limited performance on continual learning benchmarks such as ARC-AGI-3, especially when models are evaluated out of the box. Various agent harnesses have been proposed to close this gap, and each commits to a strategy for handling long sequences of observations, i.e., what information to save from the environment and how

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在长时程探索任务中，如何在有限上下文下保存完整交互历史并高效取回关键信息的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 记忆管理问题，不是预训练方法本身，但它触及长上下文之外的另一条路线：把环境交互外化为可编程记忆。对做长程推理、continual interaction、agent memory 的研究员有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRO-LONG，一个尽量轻量的上下文管理框架。核心做法是维护完整、结构化的程序化交互日志，而不是只做摘要或只保留局部窗口；再结合代码生成/程序执行能力，把需要的信息以程序化查询方式取回并装载回上下文，从而缓解“保留越多、检索越难”的矛盾。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确提到面向 long-horizon exploratory settings，并以 ARC-AGI-3 这类 continual benchmark 为动机，但给出的公开信息不足以确认具体模型规模、基线和提升幅度。可以合理预期其比较对象包括摘要式记忆、滑动窗口和检索式上下文管理；是否有干净 ablation 需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles context management for LLM agents in long-horizon exploratory tasks: how to preserve full interaction history under limited context while still retrieving the right details efficiently.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for researchers thinking about long-horizon reasoning beyond brute-force context extension. The key idea is to externalize memory into a programmable substrate rather than compress everything into text.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRO-LONG is a minimal context-management framework built around programmatic memory. Instead of relying purely on summaries or local windows, it keeps a complete structured interaction log and uses code-generation/program-execution style retrieval to query and reload relevant information into context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method on continual long-horizon benchmarks such as ARC-AGI-3, but the available metadata does not specify model sizes, exact baselines, or effect sizes. Likely comparisons include summarization-based memory, sliding windows, and retrieval-based context management; the cleanliness of the setup depends on the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory 工程而非基座方法；若你关心长程交互里的“上下文不是唯一记忆载体”，读方法图和 ablation 即可，不必通读。
recommendation.en: This is agent-memory engineering rather than foundation-model training; read the method sketch and ablations if you care about external memory as an alternative to ever-longer context.

paper.title: Self-GC: Self-Governing Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate tool results, files, plans, and user constraints that are too structured to be treated as a disposable text suffix. Current systems mostly rely on in-run heuristics such as chronological pruning and tool-output masking, or on final self-summary near a context limit. Heuristics are cheap but blind to future dependencies; summaries preserve narrative state but often hide exact evidence, locators, and editable artifacts. We present Self-GC, where GC denotes self-g

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM Agent 运行中上下文对象不断累积、简单截断或末尾总结会丢失证据和可编辑状态的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 系统方法。它把上下文管理从文本级压缩改成对象生命周期治理，对长程工具调用、文件编辑、计划维护这类 Agent 任务有工程参考价值，但距离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: Self-GC 将用户轮次、工具调用片段和技能状态转成带索引的对象，由侧通道 planner 提出 fold、mask、prune 等操作，再由执行 harness 强制可恢复 sidecar、安全提交边界和 cache-aware commit。方法核心不是训练新模型，而是给 Agent 上下文加一套类似垃圾回收的治理层。
summary.experiments: 论文在 33-session Hard Set 上评估，报告可裁剪 43.95% prefix tokens，并保留大部分运行状态；摘要未给出完整指标定义、模型规模或与更多 Agent 框架的横向对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-horizon LLM agents whose accumulated tool outputs, files, plans, and constraints cannot be safely handled as a disposable text suffix.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-systems method. It reframes context handling as object lifecycle governance rather than plain text compression, which is useful for long-running tool and file-editing agents, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Self-GC turns user turns, tool spans, and skill state into indexed objects. A side-channel planner proposes fold, mask, and prune actions, while the harness enforces recoverable sidecars, safe commit boundaries, and cache-aware commits. The novelty is a context governance layer rather than a new trained model.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a 33-session Hard Set and reports 43.95% prefix-token pruning while preserving most of the execution state. The abstract does not provide full metric definitions, model scale, or broad comparisons against other agent frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 上下文工程备查即可；看对象化状态和 commit 边界设计，别把 33-session 结果当强结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-context engineering reference; read the object lifecycle and commit-boundary design, but do not overread the 33-session result.

paper.title: ECHO: Prune to act, trace to learn with selective turn memory in agentic RL
paper.abstract: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Existing context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by truncating distant history, folding past turns into summaries, or selecting compact memory states. However, these breakthroughs introduce two coupled limitations. First, as the number of turns grows, historical observations are progressively removed or collapsed into compressed states, making it

summary.core_problem: ECHO 解决长程工具调用 agent 在有限上下文下的两个耦合问题：行动时需要压缩历史，训练时又需要知道最终奖励应该回传到哪些早期证据 turn。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 agentic RL 和 post-train 训练信号设计有启发。它强调 context management 不能只看推理时能否塞进窗口，还要保留 provenance，也就是被压缩信息来自哪个原始环境 turn。这个视角对长程 RL、deep research agent、tool-use 数据构造都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
ECHO 把历史管理拆成三个部分：history state、bounded-context reconstruction 和 source-level traceability。每个工具调用 turn 完成后，系统写入一条 compact memory record，包含局部 finding 和 source-turn pointer。远端历史不是被滚动摘要折叠成一个不可追踪状态，而是保留为一组带来源指针的 memory records。当上下文预算紧张时，策略选择有用 memory，再把这些 memory 与近期交互一起重建成下一步的 policy context。

训练上，ECHO 不把 final-outcome advantage 均匀或密集地分配到整条轨迹的所有生成 token，而是利用 memory selection 中保留的 source indices，把正向 credit 路由到 final answer、被选中的历史 evidence turns、对应 memory findings，以及执行 memory selection 的动作。它和 rolling summary 的区别在于：summary 可以延长 rollout，但原始证据来源容易丢失；ECHO 牺牲一部分自由压缩能力，换取训练时可追踪的证据路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 BrowseComp-Plus 和一组 zero-shot benchmarks，并在 dense 与 MoE backbones 上报告结果。提供内容中的主要结论是：相比 rolling-summary training，ECHO 提高准确率，同时减少 turn proliferation 和 trajectory volume，训练更集中于有用证据链。具体数值在给定内容中未完整展示，因此不宜过度解读幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和方法定义部分，重点看 context-managed multi-turn RL interface、selective turn memory、provenance-guided token-level credit assignment。实验部分主要看和 rolling summary 的对比，以及 turn 数、trajectory volume、accuracy 三者之间的关系。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以把核心思想读完；若关心 agent RL 训练实现，再细看 GRPO 形式下 advantage 如何按 source indices 分配。

summary_en.core_problem: ECHO addresses a long-horizon agent training problem: context managers help agents act under bounded windows, but collapsed or summarized history makes it hard to assign final-outcome credit back to the original evidence turns.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly relevant to agentic RL and post-training rather than base pretraining. The useful idea is that context compression should preserve provenance. A long-rollout agent needs not only a compact context for acting, but also a trace that tells the learner which earlier observations supported the successful answer. That distinction matters for tool-use RL, deep-research agents, and synthetic trajectory generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes context-managed multi-turn RL with separate notions of history state, bounded-context reconstruction, and source-level traceability. ECHO writes a compact memory record after each completed tool-use turn. Each record contains a local finding and a pointer to the original source turn. Distant history is kept as a non-collapsing set of such records. When the context budget becomes tight, the policy selects useful memory records and reconstructs the next context from those records plus recent interactions.

The learning rule uses the same source indices. Instead of applying a trajectory-level positive advantage broadly across all generated spans, ECHO routes credit to the final answer, selected historical evidence turns, their memory findings, and the memory-selection actions that built the reconstructed context. Compared with rolling summaries, the method gives up fully collapsed state compression in exchange for evidence addressability during RL.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are reported on BrowseComp-Plus and several zero-shot benchmarks, with both dense and MoE backbones. The stated result is that ECHO improves accuracy relative to rolling-summary training while reducing excessive turns and total trajectory volume. The provided text does not include the detailed tables or exact numerical gains, so the safest reading is that the contribution is the traceable-memory training interface and its empirical validation against summary-based context management.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the motivation, then read the formal interface for context-managed multi-turn RL and the sections on selective turn memory and provenance-guided credit assignment. The experiments are most useful for checking whether accuracy gains come with fewer turns and smaller trajectory volume, rather than merely longer rollouts. A 20–30 minute pass is enough for the main idea; implementation details are worth reading only if building RL pipelines for tool-using agents.

recommendation.zh: 做agentic RL或长上下文预训练的看方法部分即可，源索引记忆绑定RL信用分配的思路可以迁移到预训练的记忆机制设计中
recommendation.en: Check the method section if working on agentic RL or long-context pretraining; the source-indexed memory tied to RL credit assignment is transferable to pretraining memory mechanism design

paper.title: ACE: Pluggable Adaptive Context Elasticizer across Agents
paper.abstract: The increasing complexity of agentic tasks has led to rapidly growing trajectory lengths, which poses significant challenges for large language model (LLM) based agents with fixed context windows. Existing context management techniques, such as truncation and summarization, suffer from inherent inflexibility and irreversibility: once information is discarded or compressed, it cannot be recovered even when it becomes critically relevant in later decision steps. To address these limitations, we pr

summary.core_problem: 长轨迹Agent任务中，现有上下文管理方案（滑动窗口截断、阈值触发压缩、循环记忆、Agent自主压缩）存在两个固有缺陷：一是对所有历史步骤信息一视同仁，无法随当前决策的注意力焦点动态调整信息呈现形式；二是丢弃或压缩后的信息永久丢失，一旦后续步骤需要之前移除的细节就会引发推理错误，在固定上下文窗口约束下导致长程任务性能下降。
summary.importance: 这是一个实用的无训练Agent长上下文管理插件，对长上下文预训练研究的启发在于：上下文不必是历史信息的静态线性拼接，可以依托底层无损存储，按当前推理需求动态组装高信息密度的可见上下文，缓解长序列下的信息密度衰减和注意力分散问题。
summary.technical_approach: ACE采用两层解耦设计：第一层是无损消息存储层，永久保存每一步的原始消息和预生成的压缩摘要，全程不做覆盖修改；第二层是每步推理前动态重建的上下文编排层，针对当前任务状态，对每个历史消息做三类可逆决策：保留原文、使用压缩摘要、暂时移除。所有决策仅影响当前步送给推理模型的上下文，不改动底层存储，因此暂时移除的内容可在后续步重新引入，使用摘要的内容可随时展开为原文。整个模块作为Agent推理循环的外部wrapper实现，不需要修改Agent的动作空间、消息流，也不需要额外模型训练。
summary.experiments: 在经典ReAct框架上，ACE的上下文管理效果优于截断和各类压缩基线；作为即插即用模块，ACE适配了DeepAgent、WebThinker、MiroFlow三类不同架构的Agent框架，在多个标准长程Agent基准上相对原框架取得稳定性能提升，同时有效控制了送入模型的上下文长度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有上下文管理方法缺陷的分类梳理，以及两层弹性架构的设计思路（图1），无需深究三分类决策的具体实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing context management methods for LLM agents (sliding window truncation, threshold-triggered compression, recurrent memory, agent-controlled compression) face two inherent limitations when handling long task trajectories: they apply uniform treatment to all historical steps without adapting to the model's current attention focus, and discarded or compressed information is permanently lost, causing errors when previously removed details become relevant later in the task. This leads to degraded reasoning performance within fixed context window constraints.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a practical, training-free plugin for agent long-context management. It offers a useful design insight for long-context pretraining research: context does not need to be a static linear concatenation of history. Instead, high-information-density visible context can be dynamically assembled from an underlying lossless store to match current inference needs, reducing information density decay and attention dispersion over long sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACE uses a decoupled two-layer design. The first layer is a lossless message maintenance store that permanently retains raw messages and precomputed compressed abstractions for every historical step, with no overwrites. Before each agent decision step, a separate context orchestration layer is rebuilt from scratch. It assigns each historical message one of three fully reversible states based on current task state: keep raw content, use compressed abstraction, or temporarily exclude. State assignments only affect the context passed to the reasoning model at the current step, with no changes to underlying storage. Temporarily excluded messages can be reintroduced, and abstracted messages can be expanded to raw text in any future step. The module runs as an external wrapper around the existing agent reasoning loop, requiring no changes to agent action spaces, message flows, or model training.
summary_en.experiments: On the standard ReAct framework, ACE outperforms truncation and compression baselines on long-horizon agent tasks. As a plug-and-play module, it integrates with three additional agent frameworks (DeepAgent, WebThinker, MiroFlow) and delivers consistent performance improvements over base implementations across standard agent benchmarks, while keeping the effective context length fed to the model compact.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the categorization of existing context management failure modes and the core two-layer elastic design (Figure 1). There is no need to dive into implementation details of the specific three-way classification logic. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；可逆上下文编排是合理工程 prior，但没有强实验前别当成长上下文解法。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and ablations only; reversible context orchestration is a sound engineering prior, but not a long-context solution without stronger evidence.

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Context Rot in Long-horizon Search
paper.abstract: Extensive context has become the norm as Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-horizon tasks. The concern that increasing context length degrades model capabilities, known as context rot, has become a central issue for these applications. In this paper, we focus on deep search scenarios, aiming to investigate the rot phenomenon and its mitigation strategies. By evaluating four flagship open-source models across three benchmarks, we reveal a prevalent but unnoticed rot ph

summary.core_problem: 长程搜索 agent 在不断累积搜索结果、网页内容和中间推理后，会出现 context rot：模型更容易放弃、提前给出不确定答案，或者无法稳定完成任务。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练和后训练的启发在于，它把长上下文退化从单轮 needle test 推到真实 agent 轨迹。长上下文能力不能只看模型能否从长输入中找信息，还要看多轮工具调用、观察噪声、推理痕迹持续累积时，模型是否仍能保持任务驱动的决策。这个问题会影响 long-context pretraining eval、agent SFT/RL 数据组织、上下文压缩策略和推理时上下文管理。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先定义长程搜索的 ReAct 轨迹，包括内部 reasoning、search/visit 工具调用、环境 observation 和 finish 输出。然后构建细粒度终止状态分类，不只看答案对错，而是区分 give up、uncertain answer、confident answer、no answer 等行为。诊断阶段通过四个主流开源模型和三个 benchmark 观察 context rot，并通过 pruning 实验分析累积上下文的作用。缓解阶段评估七种上下文管理方法，分为 context compaction、context trimming、context isolation 三类；同时提出 rot-aware filtering，用拒绝采样过滤容易体现 rot 的轨迹，不改 agent 框架即可提升最终结果。
summary.experiments: 核心发现有三点。第一，长上下文退化在长程搜索中普遍存在，且随着上下文增长，直接放弃和提前输出不确定答案的比例上升。第二，退化不只由轨迹长度或交互轮数决定，累积上下文的内容本身也会触发退化；完全移除累积上下文几乎可以消除 rot 行为，但会显著增加 unfinished trajectories，说明上下文不能简单丢弃。第三，context compaction 与 context trimming 组合在成本和效果之间较均衡；sub-agent 形式的 context isolation 更依赖模型能力，强模型上可能更有效。rot-aware filtering 在三种聚合方式下带来平均 2.6%–4.9% 的性能增益，并可与上下文管理方法叠加。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟左右。优先看错误分类表和 Figure 1，理解论文所说的 context rot 具体表现。然后看 pruning 实验，它回答“是长度导致退化，还是内容导致退化”。方法部分重点看七种 context management 的触发方式、成本定义和性能对比。若做 long-context pretraining 或 agent RL，建议多看 rot-aware filtering，因为它把失败模式转成可用于采样、筛选、评估的信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies context rot in long-horizon search agents: as the agent accumulates search results, visited pages, observations, and its own reasoning traces, it becomes more likely to give up, stop early, or provide uncertain answers.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for foundation-model research is that long-context degradation is evaluated in an agentic setting rather than in a single-pass retrieval test. A model may pass needle-style benchmarks yet still degrade when context is accumulated over many tool calls with mixed-quality evidence and intermediate thoughts. This matters for long-context evaluation, agent training data design, context compression, and inference-time memory management.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize deep search as a ReAct-style trajectory with reasoning steps, search and visit tool calls, observations, and a final finish action. They introduce a termination-state taxonomy that separates giving up, uncertain answers, confident answers, and no-answer cases, allowing them to diagnose behavior beyond exact-match correctness. They then run pruning experiments to test whether rot is driven by length, turn count, or accumulated content. For mitigation, they evaluate seven context-management methods under three groups: compaction, trimming, and isolation. They also propose rot-aware filtering, a post-hoc rejection-sampling strategy that removes trajectories showing rot-like failure patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates four flagship open-source models on three benchmarks. It finds that context rot is common in long-horizon search and worsens as context grows, especially through increased give-up and premature uncertain-answer behavior. Pruning shows that the content of accumulated context matters, not just trajectory length or number of turns. Removing all accumulated context nearly eliminates rot but causes many more unfinished trajectories, so naive deletion is not a good solution. Among mitigation methods, combining context compaction and trimming gives a good cost-performance trade-off. Context isolation with sub-agent calls is more model-dependent and works better with stronger backbones. Rot-aware filtering improves average performance by 2.6% to 4.9% across three aggregation methods and can be combined with context management.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Start with the error taxonomy and Figure 1 to understand what the authors count as context rot. Then read the pruning analysis, which is the most informative diagnostic part. For practical use, focus on the comparison among compaction, trimming, and isolation, including cost and trigger frequency. Researchers working on long-context pretraining or agent RL should also read the rot-aware filtering section, since it turns an observed failure mode into a usable sampling and evaluation signal.

recommendation.zh: 对长上下文能力的评估视角有新意：从『检索不准』转到『模型主动放弃』，重点看 §3 剪枝诊断实验和 §4.1 七类方法对比表
recommendation.en: A fresh evaluation angle on long-context capabilities, shifting from 'retrieval inaccuracy' to 'models voluntarily giving up'; focus on §3 pruning diagnostics and §4.1 comparison table of the seven methods.

paper.title: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents depend on context management: systems compress, summarize, and evict old tokens so tasks can continue beyond finite windows. That is safe only when dropped information is no longer needed or has been internalized. Plans are the stress case: they are written early, used for many steps, and first to be evicted. We introduce replay pairing, a diagnostic that runs the same trajectory with and without the plan in history and measures hidden-state cosine distance. On Llama-3.1-70B,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“计划有没有帮助行为”，而是更细的一层：LLM agent 早期写下的 plan，到后续多步决策时究竟是以“窗口内反复重读的文本”存在，还是已经被模型转成了可持续的内部状态。这个问题直接关系到 context management 是否安全。若 plan 只是 context-time object，那么摘要、压缩、淘汰旧 token 时，最先被删掉的往往正是 plan，系统表面上还能跑，但决策依据已经被悄悄拿走。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它把 agent 里的“长期依赖”问题拆成了可测的表征问题，而不是只看最终成功率。这对研究长上下文、记忆、KV eviction、上下文压缩很有用。第二，它给出一个不太乐观但很清楚的结论：在标准 LLM agent 里，plan 信号在 hidden state 中衰减得很快，通常一个 action-observation cycle 内就掉 4 到 12 倍，说明模型并不会自然把计划稳定内化。对预训练和中期训练的启发是，若想让模型真正持有跨步计划，单靠 ReAct 式外显计划和更长窗口不够，可能需要专门的训练目标、记忆机制或状态持久化设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 replay pairing。对同一条 agent 轨迹，构造两个匹配条件：A 保留历史中的原始 plan；B 在重放同一轨迹时把 plan 从历史里移除。然后在每一步、每一层比较两条件 hidden state 的 cosine distance，把它当作 plan-fidelity signal。若模型真的把 plan 内化，那么删掉 plan 文本后，后续 hidden state 不应立刻大幅变化；若模型依赖每步重读 plan，则距离会在 plan 仍可见时显著、随后快速衰减。

作者先在 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 的 ReAct agent 上做主实验，再在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 上做复现与对照。一个关键技术点是他们发现 reasoning model 的 <think> trace 会污染测量：即便删掉显式 plan，旧的思维链里仍会重复 plan 内容，导致 A/B 两条件都还带着 plan 信息，距离被低估。为此他们提出 strict stripping，只在 B 条件中移除先前 <think> block，以更干净地测“plan 是否还在上下文里”。

除了直接看 hidden-state distance，作者还训练 Ridge probe 去预测 plan signal 强度，并区分 active plan 与 decayed plan。探针在 Llama 的峰值层 L32 上效果最好。作者也做了 probe transfer：用 Llama 上训练的 probe 去测 R1 strict-stripped hidden states，发现仍有一定可迁移性，但方向差异很大，说明不同模型家族编码 plan 的表征子空间并不一致。

这篇工作的边界也交代得比较清楚：它主要是 representational claim，不是强因果行为结论。作者承认 cosine distance 会混入 step index、长度、话语结构等因素；他们也指出 step index 在同层几乎可被完美解码，因此 probe 的高 AUROC 不能简单理解为“纯 plan 内容检测”。
summary.experiments:
主结果来自 ALFWorld 和 HotpotQA。Llama-3.1-70B 上，plan signal 在写完 plan 后的下一步达到 0.453，随后一个 action-observation cycle 内下降 4.1 倍，到 step +5 附近稳定在约 0.027。HotpotQA 衰减更快，达到 12.4 倍量级。这个结果支持“plan 主要靠上下文保留，而不是 hidden state 持久保存”。

探针实验里，L32 的 Ridge probe 对 signal 强度预测达到 R^2=0.875，区分 active/decayed plan 的 AUROC 为 0.999；但同层 step index 的可解码性也很高，R^2=0.978，说明这里有明显混杂。

在 reasoning model 上，若不处理 <think> 污染，R1 的 step+1 signal 只有 0.022，而 Llama 为 0.099，看起来像是 R1 几乎不编码 plan。strict stripping 后，R1 的信号在样本内提升 163%，留出集提升 153%，而对非 reasoning 的 Llama 只带来 4.8% 变化，说明这个修正主要是在消除 trace contamination。Llama 训练的 L32 probe 迁移到 R1 strict-stripped states 上，n=19 时 AUROC 0.748，p=6×10^-4；R1 自探针在两个 distilled family 上可到 1.000，但与 Llama 的方向夹角约 89.3°，说明表征方向几乎正交。

行为层面，作者做了一个压缩压力测试：naive plan eviction 会让 ALFWorld 成功率下降 34.7 个百分点，而 probe-gated re-surfacing 不能恢复，说明“检测到 plan 变弱再补救”并不容易。另一方面，strict stripping 对任务成功率影响小且不显著，L32 的统一 steering 也是 null result，这进一步说明论文主张集中在表征层，而不是已经证明了简单干预就能改进行为。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住 replay pairing 的测量逻辑。然后看方法部分里 A/B 条件如何构造，尤其是 reasoning model 的 strict stripping 细节，这是全文最容易被忽略、但决定结论是否可信的地方。

接着重点看主结果图：plan signal 随 step 的衰减曲线、不同层的峰值位置、Llama 与 R1 的对比。再看 probe 部分，注意作者自己如何处理 step index 混杂，不要只看 AUROC 数字。最后看 compression stress test，理解为什么“plan 被删掉会坏”，以及为什么简单 re-surfacing 没救回来。

预计 20 到 30 分钟能读完主要内容。若只想抓结论，看引言、主实验图、strict stripping 结果和局限性讨论即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a representation-level question: when an LLM agent writes a plan early in a trajectory, does that plan persist as internal state, or does the model keep relying on the literal plan text remaining in the context window? This matters because modern agent systems routinely summarize, compress, or evict old tokens. If plans are not internalized, context management is not a harmless systems trick; it directly removes decision-critical information.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about agent benchmarking and more about measurement. It gives a concrete way to separate behavioral usefulness from representational persistence. For pretraining and systems work, the main takeaway is sobering: standard LLM agents do not appear to carry plans forward as durable hidden state. The signal decays within one action-observation step. That has implications for long-context training, memory mechanisms, KV-cache eviction, summarization, and any attempt to treat explicit planning as a substitute for persistent state.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is replay pairing. For a fixed trajectory, the authors run two matched conditions: one keeps the original plan in history, the other replays the same trajectory with the plan removed from history. At each step and layer, they measure cosine distance between hidden states across the two runs. This distance is treated as a plan-fidelity signal. If the model has internalized the plan, removing the text should not quickly change later hidden states. If the model depends on rereading the plan from context, the difference should be large near the plan and then collapse once the plan is no longer actively represented.

They test this on ReAct agents built from Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, replicate within family on Llama-3.1-8B, and compare against DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B. A key methodological contribution is the reasoning-trace confound. In reasoning models, prior <think> blocks often restate the plan. If one removes only the explicit plan text, both replay conditions may still contain plan information, making the measured distance artificially small. Their strict stripping fix removes prior <think> blocks from the plan-removed condition, yielding a cleaner estimate of whether the plan remains available in context.

They also train Ridge probes on hidden states to predict signal magnitude and classify active versus decayed plans. The best layer is L32 in Llama. Probe transfer from Llama to R1 is only partial, and self-probes indicate that R1 uses a substantially different representational direction. The paper is careful about scope: these are representational claims, not strong causal claims about behavior. The authors explicitly note confounds from step index, history length, and discourse structure.
summary_en.experiments:
On ALFWorld with Llama-3.1-70B, the plan signal peaks at 0.453 one step after the plan is written, then drops by 4.1x within a single action-observation cycle, settling near 0.027 by step +5. On HotpotQA, the decay is even faster at 12.4x. This is the main empirical basis for the claim that plans behave like context-time objects rather than persistent internal state.

The probe analysis is strong numerically but also revealing about confounds. A Ridge probe at L32 predicts signal strength with R^2 = 0.875 and separates active from decayed plans with AUROC 0.999. But step index is also almost perfectly decodable at the same layer, with R^2 = 0.978, so part of the classification power is clearly tied to trajectory phase.

For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, naive replay pairing suggests a much smaller step+1 signal than Llama, 0.022 versus 0.099, which would imply weak plan encoding. After strict stripping, the signal increases by 163% in-sample and 153% on held-out data, while Llama changes by only 4.8%, supporting the claim that the original measurement was contaminated by reasoning traces. A Llama-trained L32 probe transferred to strict-stripped R1 states reaches AUROC 0.748 with n = 19 and p = 6e-4. R1 self-probes reach 1.000 AUROC on two distilled families, but along a direction 89.3 degrees away from Llama’s, suggesting near-orthogonal representational geometry.

They also include a compression stress test: naive plan eviction reduces ALFWorld success by 34.7 percentage points, and probe-gated resurfacing does not recover the loss. Meanwhile, strict stripping has only small, non-significant effects on task success, and uniform L32 steering is a null result. That reinforces the paper’s framing: the evidence is strongest at the representation level, not yet as a simple intervention recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first main figure to understand what replay pairing is actually measuring. Then read the method section carefully, especially how the matched replay conditions are constructed. The strict stripping treatment for reasoning models is the most important implementation detail in the paper.

After that, focus on the decay curves over steps, the layerwise peak analysis, and the Llama versus R1 comparison. In the probe section, pay attention to the step-index confound rather than just the headline AUROC. The compression stress test is worth a quick read because it connects the representational finding back to practical context management.

This is a 20 to 30 minute skim if the goal is to extract the main result and the measurement idea.

recommendation.zh: 只看 replay pairing 和衰减曲线；它把“计划已内化”的常见假设打成了可测量弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the replay-pairing setup and decay curves; it turns the usual “plans are internalized” assumption into a weak measurable signal.

paper.title: Bounded Context Management for Tabular Foundation Models on Stream Learning
paper.abstract: Tabular stream learning requires predictions on sequentially arriving examples under distribution shift. While standard methods adapt by updating model states, tabular foundation models (TFMs) make predictions conditioned on a labeled context in an in-context manner, making them a natural alternative for stream learning. This shifts the challenge from how to update the model to how to manage the context. We propose a future information view that yields three practical requirements for context ma

summary.core_problem: 研究表格基础模型在流式学习中如何在有限上下文预算下选择保留哪些带标签样本。
summary.importance: 贡献是把流式学习中的在线适应问题改写为 in-context 模型的上下文管理问题。对 LLM 预训练不是直接贡献，但对样本选择、上下文记忆和 ICL 适应有弱参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 future information view，并归纳出三条上下文管理要求：保留近期样本、保留不确定样本、删除冗余样本。CURE 策略用熵门控决定样本是否进入上下文，再用冗余感知规则驱逐样本。
summary.experiments: 在七个流式数据集上评估，CURE 相对传统流式学习方法最高取得 27.0% 相对提升；论文还报告其在多个 tabular foundation model backbone 上保持鲁棒，并在策略变体中排名第一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how tabular foundation models should manage a bounded labeled context under stream learning and distribution shift.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is to reframe online adaptation for tabular foundation models as context management rather than model-state updates. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it offers a weak signal for sample selection, contextual memory, and in-context adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a future-information view and derives three requirements for context management: preserve recent examples, retain uncertain examples, and remove redundant examples. CURE implements these ideas with entropy-gated admission and redundancy-aware eviction.
summary_en.experiments: Across seven streams, CURE reports up to 27.0% relative improvement over classical stream learners. The method is also reported to be robust across multiple tabular foundation model backbones and to rank first among policy variants.

recommendation.zh: 只看 CURE 的 admission/eviction 规则即可；它像小规模 ICL 记忆管理，不足以外推到 LLM 长上下文。
recommendation.en: Skim only the admission and eviction rules; it resembles small-scale ICL memory management but should not be over-extrapolated to LLM long-context behavior.

paper.title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: As LLM agents are deployed in long-horizon sessions, context accumulation drives up inference costs. Existing approaches utilize text pruning or dynamic memory eviction to minimize token footprints; however, their unconstrained sequence mutations alter layouts, introducing prefix mismatches and cache invalidation. This reveals a critical trade-off between text sparsity and prompt cache continuity. To address this, we present TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework. Globally,

summary.core_problem: 长会话Agent中，如何在减少上下文token成本的同时避免前缀变化导致的prompt cache失效。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧系统/策略：把“文本剪枝”与“KV/prefix cache连续性”这个工程矛盾显式化；对预训练启发有限，但对长上下文服务与agent部署很实用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出双粒度上下文管理：全局的 Ingestion-Aware Compaction 在输入闸门处稳定前缀、过滤开放环境噪声；局部的 Lifecycle-Aware Eviction 跟踪片段剩余效用，用保守的批量turn调度在相关性过期后再卸载片段，以维持cache命中。
summary.experiments: 在 PinchBench 与 Claw-Eval 的 isolated/continuous 两种模式下评测；摘要声称成本降低约61%/56%（具体指标与质量损失未在摘要展开）。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon LLM agents, reduce context token cost without breaking prompt-cache continuity due to prefix mutations.
summary_en.importance: Inference-time systems contribution: makes the pruning vs cache-continuity trade-off explicit; limited pretraining impact but practical for long-context serving and agent deployments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-granularity context management: global Ingestion-Aware Compaction stabilizes prefixes and filters open-world noise; local Lifecycle-Aware Eviction tracks residual utility and evicts in conservative batch-turn schedules to preserve cache hits.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on PinchBench and Claw-Eval in isolated and continuous modes; claims ~61%/56% cost reduction (quality trade-offs not detailed in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 工程味很重：如果你在做长会话服务，只看它如何“稳定前缀以保cache”；对建模/预训练没新东西。
recommendation.en: Mostly systems engineering: read only for the prefix-stabilization idea to preserve caching; little to learn for modeling or pretraining.

paper.title: LLM-as-Code Agentic Programming for Agent Harness
paper.abstract: Every major LLM agent framework gives the LLM the role of orchestrator; the model decides what to do next, when to call tools, and when to stop. We argue that token explosion, control-flow hallucination, and unreliable completion are not implementation bugs but architectural consequences of assigning the deterministic work of looping, branching, and sequencing to a probabilistic system. A better prompt or a stronger model cannot guarantee the reliability of the LLM agent. We therefore propose Ag

summary.core_problem: 重新设计 agent 执行架构，避免让 LLM 负责循环、分支、停止条件等确定性控制流而导致 token 膨胀和控制流幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 系统架构创新：论文反对“LLM 作为总调度器”的默认设计，主张由程序掌控控制流，只在需要推理或生成的位置调用 LLM。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic Programming 和 LLM-as-Code。程序决定执行路径、循环和分支，LLM 作为可调用的自适应组件嵌入其中；每次调用内部仍保留模型生成自由，但不能改变程序执行路径。上下文由执行历史的调用树构造，形成 DAG，每次调用的上下文长度由其依赖子图决定。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模或量化结果。主要技术主张是通过程序化控制流和 DAG 上下文构造，降低长轨迹 agent 的 token 爆炸、错误停止和控制流漂移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a different agent execution architecture to avoid using an LLM for deterministic control flow such as loops, branches, sequencing, and stopping.
summary_en.importance: It is an agent-systems architecture contribution. It challenges the common LLM-as-orchestrator pattern and argues for program-owned control flow with the LLM invoked only where reasoning or generation is needed.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agentic Programming treats the LLM as an adaptive callable component, or LLM-as-Code. The program governs execution, while each LLM call remains locally flexible. Context is built from the execution call tree, yielding a DAG whose dependency structure determines per-call context length.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report benchmarks, model sizes, or quantitative gains. The proposed benefits are reduced token growth, fewer control-flow hallucinations, and more reliable completion through deterministic program control.

recommendation.zh: 这篇的 prior 很工程但判断准；看 DAG context 设计即可，别期待它解决模型能力问题。
recommendation.en: The engineering prior is sound; read the DAG-context design, but do not expect it to fix the model’s underlying competence.

paper.title: Organize then Retrieve: Hierarchical Memory Navigation for Efficient Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their inherent statelessness, requiring all task-relevant information to be encoded in growing input contexts. The resulting degraded reasoning quality, increased inference cost, and higher latency necessitate efficient working memory mechanisms. However, existing approaches either rely on lossy compression or similarity-based retrieval, which often fail to capture temporal structure and causal dependencies required for mu

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 在上下文不断膨胀时，如何保留任务相关细节并高效检索的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 工作记忆设计问题，不直接推进基座预训练，但对长轨迹任务中的记忆组织、检索粒度和时序依赖建模有一定启发，属于系统方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HORMA，将 agent 经验组织成类似文件系统的层级记忆：上层是结构化摘要与实体组织，下层保留原始轨迹；检索时不是单纯相似度召回，而是沿层级结构做导航式访问，从而同时保留抽象概览和可回溯细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示其目标场景是多步 agentic 任务，重点比较对象应包括压缩式记忆和相似度检索式记忆。论文主张该方法在推理质量、延迟和上下文成本之间取得更好平衡，但从摘要看不到是否覆盖强基线、是否做了足够干净的长轨迹消融，因此结论更适合作为系统设计信号而非稳定方法学结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Duke University 和 Snowflake AI Research。Yuxiong He 在大模型系统与训练基础设施方向有较强代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how to preserve task-relevant details while retrieving efficiently for long-horizon LLM agents whose context keeps growing over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a working-memory design problem for agents. It does not directly advance foundation-model pretraining, but it offers some useful ideas on memory organization, retrieval granularity, and temporal dependency handling in long trajectories. The contribution is mainly a systems/method design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HORMA, which organizes agent experience into a file-system-like hierarchy: upper levels store structured summaries and entities, while lower levels keep raw trajectories. Retrieval is done through navigation over the hierarchy rather than pure similarity search, aiming to combine abstract overview with recoverable detail.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the target setting is multi-step agentic tasks, likely compared against compression-based memory and similarity-retrieval baselines. The claimed gains are better reasoning quality, latency, and context efficiency trade-offs. But the abstract does not reveal whether the baselines are strong enough or whether the long-horizon ablations are clean, so the result is more a systems signal than a robust methodological conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Duke University and Snowflake AI Research. Yuxiong He is well known for large-model systems and training infrastructure work.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但如果你在做 agent memory 或长轨迹上下文管理，只看方法图和检索消融即可，别把它当成可迁移到 pretrain 的强结论。
recommendation.en: Limited value for pretraining itself; if you care about agent memory or long-trajectory context management, read the method figure and retrieval ablations only, and do not overgeneralize it into a pretraining result.

paper.title: ActiveMem: Distributed Active Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Memory is essential for enabling large language model (LLM) agents to handle long-horizon reasoning tasks. Existing memory mechanisms are largely centralized, typically organizing retrieved information and interaction history within a single model context. This design imposes a fundamental trade-off: scaling reasoning trajectories risks context overload, whereas aggressive content pruning may result in irreversible information loss. Seeking a better trade-off, we draw inspiration from human cogn

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM reasoning/agent 任务中集中式 memory 造成的上下文过载与信息丢失之间的取舍。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent memory 架构改进。它对预训练本身不直接，但对长上下文模型如何外接记忆、如何避免把所有历史塞进 context，有工程和建模层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ActiveMem，将 agent 记忆从核心推理过程解耦。高层 Planner 使用蒸馏后的 semantic gists 进行推理，轻量级分布式 memory 组件负责保存、更新和提供细节信息，从而避免单一上下文承载全部历史。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出 benchmark、模型规模、记忆模块规模、上下文长度、baseline 或提升幅度；无法判断效果是否来自架构本身，还是来自更强的摘要/检索策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the overload-versus-information-loss trade-off in centralized memory designs for long-horizon LLM reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory architecture. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to how long-context models should be coupled with external memory rather than treating context length as the only knob.
summary_en.technical_approach: ActiveMem decouples memory from the core reasoning loop. A high-level planner reasons over distilled semantic gists, while lightweight distributed memory components maintain and retrieve detailed information outside the main context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks, model sizes, memory-module size, context length, baselines, or numerical gains, so the cleanliness of the setup cannot be assessed from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory 设计备查即可；关键要看消融是否排除了普通摘要器带来的收益。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-memory design reference; the key ablation is whether gains survive against a strong summarizer baseline.

paper.title: Learning What to Remember: Observability-Safe Memory Retention via Constrained Optimization for Long-Horizon Language Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon language agents accumulate observations, reasoning traces, and retrieved facts that exceed their finite context windows, making memory retention a fundamental resource-allocation problem. Existing memory systems improve management through heuristic scoring, retrieval optimization, or learned compression, but largely treat retention as a local decision problem and do not explicitly model its long-term consequences under realistic observability constraints. To fill this gap, we formul

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程语言智能体在有限上下文窗口下，如何在保留记忆时同时考虑预算约束、未来遗漏代价和信息陈旧风险的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 agent memory 管理方法论文，贡献不在预训练本身，而在把记忆保留从启发式打分改写为带约束的随机优化问题，并强调训练时可见监督与部署时可观测特征必须严格分离，避免 offline-only 信号泄漏到在线决策。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OSL-MR（Observability-Safe Learning for Memory Retention）。核心做法是定义 observability-safe 的训练框架：在线策略只能使用部署时可观测特征，离线监督只用于训练 evidence learner；再结合预算可行性、证据效用、miss penalty、重新获取延迟和 stale risk 等延迟成本，学习记忆保留策略，而不是逐条局部打分。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模和主 baseline 数字。可确认的是，评测围绕长时程 agent memory retention，比较对象应包括启发式记忆打分、检索优化或压缩式记忆系统；论文主张其方法在现实可观测约束下更稳健，但缺少摘要级别的量化结果，需读正文确认 setup 是否干净、收益是否来自更强监督而非 formulation 本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles memory retention for long-horizon language agents under finite context windows, where retention decisions must account for budget limits, delayed miss costs, and stale-information risk.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-memory paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its main contribution is to cast memory retention as a constrained stochastic optimization problem and to enforce a strict separation between offline supervision and online-observable features, which is a useful systems principle.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes OSL-MR, an observability-safe framework for memory retention. The method trains an evidence learner from realized supervision available offline, while constraining the deployed policy to use only online-observable signals. The objective explicitly models budget feasibility, evidence utility, miss penalties, reacquisition delay, and stale-memory costs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset sizes, or concrete gains. The evaluation appears to compare against heuristic scoring, retrieval-based memory management, and learned compression baselines in long-horizon agent settings. The claimed benefit is robustness under realistic observability constraints, but the quantitative strength and cleanliness of the setup need verification in the main paper.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 帮助有限，但“训练可见信号与部署可观测信号分离”这个约束很干净，做 agent memory 或 RL 数据闭环的人可只看 formulation。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the train-time vs deploy-time observability split is a clean idea; worth skimming the formulation if you work on agent memory or RL data loops.

paper.title: Signal-Driven Observation for Long-Horizon Web Agents
paper.abstract: Web agents operating over long horizons ingest raw DOM and accessibility trees -- routinely tens of thousands of tokens -- at every action step, causing progressive context degradation that erodes reasoning well before tasks complete. We argue that this coupling of observation frequency to action frequency is an architectural mistake. Drawing on the insight from Recursive Language Models that querying a document outperforms reading it wholesale, we propose Signal-Driven Observation (SDO): a dedi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注长程 web agent 的一个结构性问题：每一步动作都重新吞下整棵 DOM / accessibility tree，会让上下文迅速膨胀并在任务完成前就损伤推理。
summary.importance: 价值在于它把“观察频率应不应等于动作频率”明确提出为 agent 架构问题，而不是单纯靠更长上下文硬扛。对做长上下文、检索式读写分离和 agent memory 的研究员有一点启发，但离基座 pretrain 仍较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Signal-Driven Observation（SDO）：引入一个专门的子调用读取完整 DOM，但只返回与当前任务相关的元素及 selector；并且只有在信号检测器触发时才重新观察，例如 URL 变化、新交互元素出现、动作失败或外部浏览器事件。核心思想是把 observation compression 作为架构层决策。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，这更像方法提案或立场论文，未看到完整 benchmark、模型规模或量化结果。实验部分大概率不是重点，主要贡献是问题定义与设计原则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural issue in long-horizon web agents: re-ingesting full DOM and accessibility trees at every action step causes context bloat and degrades reasoning before tasks finish.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is conceptual: observation frequency should not necessarily equal action frequency. That is mildly relevant to researchers thinking about long-context architectures, retrieval-style reading, and agent memory, though it is still far from core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Signal-Driven Observation (SDO) adds a dedicated sub-call that reads the full DOM but returns only task-relevant elements and selectors. Re-observation happens only when a lightweight signal detector fires, such as on URL transitions, newly visible interactive elements, action failures, or exogenous browser events.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, this looks more like an architectural proposal or position paper than a fully validated benchmark-heavy study. No concrete model sizes, datasets, or quantitative gains are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 想法是对的：agent 不该每步全量读页面；但目前更像 design memo，不像完成度高的论文，知道这个分离观察/行动的 framing 就够了。
recommendation.en: The framing is right—agents should not fully reread the page every step—but this reads more like a design memo than a finished paper; keep the observation/action decoupling idea and move on.

paper.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) deployments for long-horizon tasks face a fundamental constraint: context windows are finite while productive work sessions are not. When history exceeds the Maximum Effective Context Window (MECW), critical structured information - architectural decisions, task transitions, file histories - is silently discarded. Existing mitigations treat history as flat text, destroying the relational structure that makes sessions resumable. We present TokenMizer, an open-source pro

summary.core_problem: 解决长周期 LLM 工作会话中历史上下文超出有效窗口后，关键结构化信息被压缩或丢弃的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向部署侧的上下文管理系统，关注 token 经济性、会话恢复和长期任务连续性。它不是模型架构或预训练方法，但对长上下文 serving、agent memory 和会话压缩有一定工程参考。
summary.technical_approach: TokenMizer 将会话历史建模为 typed knowledge graph，定义 14 类节点和 7 类边；用混合抽取管线增量填充图结构，再通过三层 checkpoint 机制序列化为紧凑 resume blocks。系统还包含 8 层压缩管线和 semantic cache，用于减少上下文占用和重复查询延迟。
summary.experiments: 在一个受控 benchmark 上评估，共 21 个 sessions、覆盖 5 个领域。摘要称取得明显 token economy，并改善长会话恢复，但样本规模较小，且未看到与强记忆系统、RAG memory 或长上下文模型的充分对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-running LLM sessions where useful structured history is lost once the conversation exceeds the effective context window.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a deployment-side context-management system focused on token economy, resumability, and long-horizon session continuity. It is not a pretraining or architecture paper, but it has some engineering relevance for long-context serving and agent memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: TokenMizer represents session history as a typed knowledge graph with 14 node types and 7 edge types. A hybrid extraction pipeline incrementally populates the graph, a three-tier checkpointing scheme serializes it into compact resume blocks, and an eight-layer compression pipeline plus semantic cache reduces context cost and repeated-query latency.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on a controlled benchmark of 21 sessions across five domains. The abstract reports significant token savings, but the evaluation appears small and does not clearly establish comparison against strong memory, RAG, or long-context baselines.

recommendation.zh: 工程想法合理但证据偏轻；只看 schema、checkpoint 设计和压缩流水线，别把它当长上下文结论。
recommendation.en: The engineering idea is sensible but lightly evidenced; read the schema, checkpointing, and compression pipeline, not the claims as long-context science.

Chief among them is managing context windows without losing accuracy or efficiency. When developers inject full project documentation and code into a model's memory, the model loses mid-sequence information, token costs spiral, and architecture drifts. summary.core_problem: AI代码生成中，将整个项目文档和代码注入模型上下文导致中段信息丢失、token成本激增和架构漂移。

summary.technical_approach: 将上下文分配建模为在token预算约束下最大化语义相关性的优化问题；设计动态路由器按需选择语义相关的skill capsule，而非输入整个代码库。

summary.authors_note: 作者机构信息未在摘要中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Feeding an entire codebase into an LLM context window causes mid-sequence information loss, spiraling token costs, and architecture drift in AI code generation.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MicroSkill Architecture, a modular knowledge encapsulation paradigm inspired by microservices, to partition knowledge into atomic skill capsules and route only semantically relevant ones to the agent.

recommendation.en: Conceptually interesting but operates at software engineering architecture level; limited methodological value for LLM pretrain researchers—glance only.

paper.title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents -- Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism

summary.core_problem: 在长轨迹搜索型 agent 中，随着工具调用累积大量 observation，把“过时 observation”从上下文中 mask 掉是一种极简的上下文管理策略；但它到底在什么条件下提升准确率、什么条件下反而伤害性能，以及背后的机制是什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“训练动态/数据效率/长上下文使用方式”有间接启发：它把一个看似工程性的 context management 变成可预测的“regime map”（不同模型容量×检索器强度×基线能力下的收益曲线），这类规律常用于反推模型在上下文利用上的瓶颈（检索噪声、注意力分配、错误证据固化）。如果你在做 agentic 数据合成、或用长轨迹工具数据做 continual pretrain/mid-train，这篇的结论能帮助决定：该不该在训练数据里显式加入 observation 丢弃/压缩策略，避免让模型学到依赖陈旧证据的坏习惯。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是系统性 sweep：跨多个 agent backbone（4B 到 284B）、三种 retriever、离线与 live-web 的搜索基准，对比“无管理”与“mask stale observations”的策略。核心产出不是一个新算法，而是经验规律与机制解释：当把“mask 带来的 accuracy gain”对“未做管理时的基线 accuracy”作图时，呈现非对称倒 U：弱 retriever 下几乎是平台期（mask 不怎么帮忙）；强 retriever + 中等容量模型时出现峰值（mask 显著提升）；当模型足够强时出现陡峭崩塌（mask 反而伤害）。论文还试图解释崩塌机制：强模型可能已经能在长上下文中做更精细的证据整合/纠错，粗暴 mask 会删掉对后续推理仍有用的“远期但关键”的证据，或破坏模型形成的内部检索链路。
summary.experiments: 你给的全文片段主要展示了一个 live-web 轨迹案例（搜索引擎把 2003 误导到 2023，agent 在 query reformulation 中振荡），用来说明长轨迹中 observation 会变“陈旧/误导”。摘要声称做了：多模型（4B–284B）、三 retriever、离线+在线基准的系统 sweep，并得到倒 U 形 regime map。但在当前片段里还看不到具体 benchmark 名称、mask 策略的精确定义（如何判定 stale、mask 粒度）、以及关键数值（提升/下降幅度）。如果全文里给了曲线与分段阈值，那部分会是主要可复用资产。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（~20–30 分钟）：
1）先找“mask stale observations”的形式化定义：stale 判定规则、mask 的位置与粒度（token/span/整段 observation）。
2）直接看 regime map 的主图：横轴基线 accuracy、纵轴 gain 的倒 U 形，以及不同 retriever/模型容量的分层。
3）再看机制分析部分：作者如何证明是“证据整合/噪声抑制”而不是别的 confound（例如上下文长度减少带来的纯粹困惑度变化）。
4）最后扫案例与失败模式：强模型崩塌区间到底删掉了什么信息。若你关心 pretrain 数据构造，重点是把这些失败模式转成训练数据的过滤/压缩策略。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon web/search agents, masking stale observations is a minimal context-management intervention. The paper asks when it helps, when it hurts, and what mechanism explains the transition across regimes.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but relevant to training dynamics and data efficiency for agentic trajectories: it turns a heuristic (drop old tool outputs) into a predictable regime map over model capacity and retriever strength. If you generate agentic data for SFT/RL or do continual/mid-training on long tool trajectories, the results inform whether to bake observation dropping/compression into the data pipeline, and when that will backfire by removing long-range evidence the model could have used.
summary_en.technical_approach: They run a systematic sweep across agent backbones (4B–284B) and three retrievers on both offline and live-web search benchmarks, comparing a baseline agent to one that masks stale observations as the trajectory grows. The main empirical pattern is an asymmetric inverted-U when plotting masking-induced accuracy gain against baseline accuracy: (i) a plateau under weak retrievers, (ii) a peak when a strong retriever is paired with a mid-capacity model, and (iii) a sharp collapse for sufficiently strong models where masking becomes harmful. The proposed mechanism is that masking primarily mitigates retrieval noise and reduces distraction for mid-capacity models, but for strong models it deletes still-relevant long-range evidence and disrupts multi-step evidence chains the model can otherwise maintain.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt includes a live-web trajectory illustrating how search bias (2003 vs 2023) can cause oscillatory query reformulations and accumulation of misleading observations. The abstract claims broad sweeps (multiple model sizes, three retrievers, offline + live-web benchmarks) and the regime-map curve, but the excerpt does not expose key experimental specifics: benchmark names, the exact stale-detection rule, masking granularity, or numeric effect sizes. In the full paper, the main reusable artifact should be the regime-map plots and the breakdown by retriever/model size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~20–30 min):
- First locate the formal definition of “stale” and the masking operator (span vs whole observation; how staleness is detected).
- Jump to the main regime-map figure(s): inverted-U curve, stratified by retriever strength and model size.
- Read the mechanism section next: what evidence supports the noise-reduction vs evidence-deletion explanation, and what confounds are controlled.
- Finally scan failure cases in the collapse regime to understand what information gets removed and why strong models suffer. Translate those into data-pipeline rules if you train on long tool trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 别把“丢旧上下文”当万能招：这篇把收益/崩盘的分界条件讲清楚，读 regime map 和机制消融就够，用来校准长轨迹 agent 的上下文策略。
recommendation.en: Don’t treat “drop old context” as a universal fix: the regime map + mechanism ablations are the value—skim those to calibrate context/memory policies for long-horizon agents.

paper.title: Learning Agent-Compatible Context Management for Long-Horizon Tasks
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks such as web search and deep research in real-world applications, where accumulated context can cause long-context degradation and reasoning failures. Prior work mitigates this through context management with agent-side context control or fixed strategies such as summarization, which require training the agent itself for adaptation - making it impractical for closed-source agents and ignoring that different agents may require different strategies. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长程 Agent 中的上下文管理问题：轨迹、工具结果和中间推理不断累积后，长上下文退化会导致约束遗忘、过早放弃和重复探索。传统做法多让 Agent 自己总结或调用上下文工具，但这要求 Agent 具备相应协议能力，也不适合闭源模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“长上下文可用性”从窗口长度问题转成了 Agent 兼容的上下文分布问题。同样的原始轨迹，对不同能力模型未必都是有益输入；弱模型可能需要更强压缩来降低推理负担，强模型则能保留更多原始证据以维持 fidelity。这个观察对长上下文预训练和 Agent 后训练都有意义：训练目标不能只奖励装入更多 token，还要奖励模型在被裁剪、压缩、重排后的上下文上稳定执行。
summary.technical_approach: AdaCoM 使用一个外部 context manager 管理上下文，任务 Agent 保持冻结。基础流程是 ReAct Agent 在第 t 轮基于 managed context 生成动作，环境返回 observation 后，manager 接收当前上下文并输出结构化修改动作，得到下一轮 managed context。方法有两个关键设计。第一是架构解耦：manager 可以是较小 LLM，不需要训练或修改闭源 Agent。第二是操作灵活：不预设只做摘要，而是允许 manager 对上下文任意部分进行编辑、保留、压缩或重组。manager 通过端到端强化学习训练，奖励来自最终任务表现，因此学到的是某个冻结 Agent 真正能用好的上下文形态，而不是人工规定的摘要格式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 web search 和 deep research 类型长程任务，并在多种 Agent 上测试。论文报告 AdaCoM 能明显改善任务表现，主要通过减少约束遗忘、过早放弃和冗余探索来取得收益。分析部分提出 Fidelity–Reliability Trade-off：以 vanilla ReAct 表现衡量 Agent 能力时，强 Agent 的 manager 倾向保留更多原始轨迹以减少信息损失；弱 Agent 的 manager 更倾向激进压缩，以降低长上下文干扰并提高执行可靠性。迁移实验显示，训练好的 manager 更容易在能力相近的 Agent 之间迁移，而跨能力层级迁移效果较弱。给定内容未提供具体提升数字，精读时需要回到主实验表格核对各 benchmark 和各 Agent 的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 AdaCoM 方法部分，特别是 managed context 的递推定义、manager 的结构化修改动作空间和强化学习训练流程。实验部分优先看三个信息：不同 Agent 上 AdaCoM 相对 vanilla ReAct 和固定摘要策略的提升；manager 学到的上下文长度和压缩比例；跨 Agent 迁移矩阵。最值得带走的是 Fidelity–Reliability Trade-off，因为它解释了为什么单一摘要策略很难适配所有模型，也解释了为什么长上下文能力评估应同时看信息保真和推理稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context management for long-horizon LLM agents. As actions, observations, tool outputs, and intermediate reasoning accumulate, the growing context can hurt later decisions. Existing approaches often ask the agent itself to summarize or manage context, which is fragile for frozen or closed-source agents and assumes a single management strategy works across models.
summary_en.importance: The useful insight is that long-context performance is not only about context-window size. It is also about whether the presented context distribution is compatible with a particular agent. Stronger agents can often use more raw trajectory evidence, while weaker agents may need more aggressive compression to avoid distraction and instruction drift. This has implications for long-context pretraining and agent post-training: models should be trained not just to accept many tokens, but to operate reliably under edited, compressed, and reorganized contexts.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaCoM introduces an external context manager while keeping the task agent frozen. In a ReAct-style workflow, the agent acts on a managed context; after the environment returns an observation, the manager receives the updated context and emits a structured modification action; applying this action produces the next managed context. The design has two important choices. First, context management is architecturally decoupled from the task agent, so it can be used with closed-source or otherwise untrainable agents. Second, the manager is not restricted to a fixed summarization operation. It can flexibly edit, retain, compress, or reorganize different parts of the trajectory. The manager is trained with end-to-end reinforcement learning using task success signals, so the learned policy is optimized for what the frozen agent can actually use.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers long-horizon web search and deep research tasks across multiple agents. AdaCoM is reported to improve performance by reducing constraint forgetting, premature abandonment, and redundant exploration. The analysis identifies a Fidelity–Reliability trade-off: managers paired with stronger agents preserve more raw trajectory content to maintain evidence fidelity, while managers paired with weaker agents compress more aggressively to keep reasoning reliable. Transfer experiments show that a trained manager transfers best between agents of similar capability, and less reliably across different capability tiers. The provided text does not include exact performance numbers, so the main tables should be checked for benchmark-level gains and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the AdaCoM workflow, the managed-context recurrence, the action space for structured context modification, and the reinforcement learning setup. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against vanilla ReAct and fixed summarization, the learned context-length or compression behavior, and the transfer matrix across agents. The most relevant part for foundation-model researchers is the Fidelity–Reliability trade-off, because it connects long-context degradation to model capability and suggests why a single context-management heuristic is unlikely to fit all agents.

recommendation.zh: 重点看第5节的Fidelity-Reliability Trade-off实验结论，对长上下文Agent的后训练与策略设计有实际参考价值
recommendation.en: Focus on the Fidelity-Reliability Trade-off results in Section 5, which has practical reference value for post-training and strategy design of long-context agents

paper.title: SAM: State-Adaptive Memory for Long-Horizon Reasoning Agent
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agentic reasoning requires large language models to act over long interaction histories containing thoughts, tool calls, observations, and partial conclusions. The challenge is not merely that these histories grow long, but that information needed for the current decision may be scattered across distant steps and only become relevant later. summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 推理中，交互历史持续增长，关键信息分散在远距离步骤里，现有截断、压缩或检索方法难以随 Agent 当前状态动态调整记忆访问。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 记忆机制改进。它把长程推理中的上下文管理问题明确表述为 state-adaptive memory，而不是单纯的长上下文压缩或固定检索，对通用 Agent 的执行轨迹管理有一定参考价值。

summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模、基线名称和数值结果。可确认的是论文针对长程 agentic reasoning 场景评估 SAM，并与截断、压缩、检索式历史复用等现有范式形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents accumulate long interaction traces, where information needed for the current decision may be scattered across distant prior thoughts, tool calls, observations, and partial conclusions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent memory design rather than a base-model training method. Its useful angle is to frame trajectory management as state-adaptive access, not just context truncation, summarization, or static retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAM keeps compact memory cues while preserving raw trajectory pages. The cues act as lightweight intent-conditioned pointers for recall rather than lossy replacements for the history, allowing memory access to change with the evolving agent state.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It states that SAM is evaluated for long-horizon agentic reasoning against common history truncation, compression, and retrieval-style approaches.

recommendation.zh: Agent 记忆论文里算 setup 比较干净的一类；预训练侧不必细读，扫方法图看它如何区分 cue 和 raw page 即可。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean agent-memory setup; for pretraining work, skim the method figure and the cue-versus-raw-page design, not the full paper.
